Name: (CP)TT's Ocean Blue Furniture
Author: lll98lll
Description:
使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]ContentPatcher[/b][/url]向游戏内添加了一套海洋主题的蓝色家具。我对这个蓝色非常满意！
可以在家具目录中找到，使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675][b]Happy Home Designer[/b][/url]会更加方便，搜索TT或是ocean或是blue都可以找到我的家具。

Added a set of ocean themed blue furniture to the game using ContentCatcher. I am very satisfied with this blue color!
You can find it in the furniture catalog, and using Happy Home Designer would be more convenient. You can search for TT, ocean, or blue to find them.
